name: Photographic records
description: Detailed description for photographic materials — suitable for photo archives, press photography, and documentary photography. Based on VRA Core and SPECTRUM.

fields.name: photo_technique
fields.label: Photographic technique
fields.help_text: The photographic process used to create the image

fields.name: photo_dimensions
fields.label: Dimensions
fields.help_text: Physical dimensions of the original (height × width)

fields.name: photo_digital_resolution
fields.label: Digital resolution
fields.help_text: Resolution of the digital capture or born-digital image

fields.name: photo_photographer
fields.label: Photographer
fields.help_text: Prefer linking via Agents tab for authority-controlled names

fields.name: photo_studio
fields.label: Studio / agency
fields.help_text: Studio or agency the image originates from

fields.name: photo_date_captured
fields.label: Date captured
fields.placeholder: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY or circa YYYY
fields.help_text: Date the photograph was taken; use 'circa' or '?' for uncertain dates

fields.name: photo_location_captured
fields.label: Location captured
fields.help_text: Use Places tab for geo-coordinates and Wikidata links

fields.name: photo_depicted_persons
fields.label: Depicted persons
fields.placeholder: Names of persons visible in the image
fields.help_text: One per line; link via Agents tab for authority-controlled names

fields.name: photo_caption
fields.label: Original caption
fields.placeholder: Caption as it appeared on the original or accompanying the image
fields.help_text: Transcribe the original caption verbatim if possible

fields.name: photo_negative_number
fields.label: Negative / reference number
fields.placeholder: Original negative or archive reference number
fields.help_text: Internal numbering system of the producing studio or agency

fields.name: photo_condition_notes
fields.label: Condition notes
fields.placeholder: Describe any damage, deterioration, or special storage needs
fields.help_text: Fading, foxing, tears, silver mirroring, vinegar syndrome etc.

fields.name: photo_digitisation_date
fields.label: Digitisation date
fields.help_text: Date the physical item was digitised

fields.name: photo_digitised_by
fields.label: Digitised by
fields.placeholder: Person or organisation responsible for digitisation
fields.help_text: Scanner operator, external service provider etc.

fields.name: photo_usage_restrictions
fields.label: Usage restrictions
fields.placeholder: Any specific restrictions on use or reproduction
fields.help_text: e.g. portrait rights, sensitive content, donor restrictions
